property_summary: Invariant: calling transfer(...) on C with a callee address that causes the external low-level call to revert must never succeed (reference always results in transfer returning false via revert handling) — the buggy variant permits passing address(0) which makes the contract attempt a low-level call to address(0) that behaves differently, so for some inputs the observable post-call success differs; the test asserts that for all fuzzed inputs where the helper reverts, C.transfer call fails (ok == false) because reference blocks address(0) while the mutant allowing address(0) can change behavior.
change_summary: Relax validAddress to allow the zero address (remove the require that forbids address(0)), which can change behavior when transfer is called with contract_address == address(0).
